use_case_name: Update the Facility Map and Displayed Devices

claims.content: To allow the facility map to be modified and devices to be added and removed from the display without requiring programming effort.

goal.raw_text: To allow the facility map to be modified and devices to be added and removed from the display without requiring programming effort.

claims.content: System Administrator
The GUI allows the facility map to be modified without requiring programming effort.
The GUI allows devices to be added and removed from the display without requiring programming effort.
The System Administrator modifies the facility map or adds and removes devices from the display without requiring programming effort.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator modifies the facility map or adds and removes devices from the display without requiring programming effort.

claims.content: System Administrator modifies the facility map using the GUI without requiring programming effort.
System Administrator adds and removes devices from the display using the GUI without requiring programming effort.
The GUI configuration screen displays to the user which device, controller, or workstation in the RLCS network will be affected by the changes.
When the System Administrator modifies the database tables, the GUI analyzes the data before storing in the database.
The GUI notifies the System Administrator of any conflicting or redundant entries.
The RLCS software accommodates future changes to the roadway by updating non-volatile memory-based tables without requiring programming effort.
The facility map on the screen refreshes every 2 seconds but can be configurable within the database to more than 2 seconds by the user.

If the GUI identifies conflicting or redundant entries when the System Administrator modifies the database tables, the GUI notifies the System Administrator of the conflicting or redundant entries before storing in the database.

If future changes to the roadway include a change in the number of closure devices, a change in the number of entrances to lanes, a change in the number of changeable message signs, different closure devices, or different operational procedures, updating non-volatile memory-based tables is sufficient to accommodate the changes without requiring programming effort.
If the user configures the database so the facility map refresh interval is more than 2 seconds, the facility map on the screen refreshes at that configured interval.

Exception path: When the System Administrator modifies the database tables, the GUI analyzes the data before storing in the database and notifies the System Administrator of any conflicting or redundant entries. Exit: The GUI notifies the System Administrator of any conflicting or redundant entries before storing the data in the database.
The facility map has been modified without requiring programming effort.
Devices have been added and removed from the display without requiring programming effort.
The GUI configuration screen has displayed to the user which device, controller, or workstation in the RLCS network will be affected by the changes.
The GUI has analyzed the data before storing it in the database.
The System Administrator has been notified of any conflicting or redundant entries.
The facility map on the screen refreshes every 2 seconds, but can be configured within the database to more than 2 seconds by the user.
